sut.name: TrainTicket
sut.deploy: k8s/minikube via make deploy (with OTel->Jaeger tracing)

ground_truth.label: negative
ground_truth.rationale: Clean control: the flag is off, so the route is persisted normally and the read-back GET lists it. The differential read-back oracle must NOT fire here. This is the per-case specificity check that pairs with the positive case (same input, fault off).

provenance.notes: Negative control paired 1:1 with the positive case. A false flag here would mean the read-back oracle fires on a normal successful write (a false positive). Traces + read-back to be captured at Gate 1.
